title: AI & Data Science Engineer
bio: I'm a Computer Science graduate specializing in AI and Data Science. I like building stuff with AI, especially computer vision and machine learning projects, and I'm usually curious enough to go down a rabbit hole when something catches my attention. A lot of my work is basically experimenting, breaking things, figuring out why they broke, and eventually getting them to work the way I wanted.
